comment: The names usable as one bus key segment: unit, parameter, entity, aspect, room and zone names, and every segment the SDK builds a key from. ASCII letters and digits, "_", "-" and ".", except "." and "..". "/" breaks the key schema, "*", "$", "?" and "#" mean something to the bus, and "**" would reach every aspect subscriber. Read by src/validate.rs (unit test) and sdk/python/tests/test_keys.py, so the core and the SDK accept and refuse the same names.
